## Research interests

I work in nonlinear analysis applied to partial differential equations. My main focus is the semilinear wave equation under Dirichlet periodic conditions, together with elliptic boundary value problems, singular fourth order ordinary differential equations arising in nanobeam and MEMS models, and delay functional differential equations. I combine topological methods, in particular Leray-Schauder degree theory, with numerical methods such as shooting methods, finite elements, and spectral or FFT techniques.

Older working papers, theses, and course notes, mostly in Spanish, are collected separately on the [Trabajos](/trabajos/index.qmd) page.
